from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    candidates = [v for v in counts if v not in (0, background)]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = min(candidates, key=lambda v: (counts[v], v))
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in coords), max(r for r, c in coords)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in coords), max(c for r, c in coords)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in coords]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = marker
    return out
